item.title: Eurostar services disrupted after bomb alert at French station
item.body: Passengers at St Pancras station in London were facing long queues after several Eurostar services were disrupted following a bomb alert at a French train station.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🚄 Eurostar services disrupted after bomb alert at French station

Passengers at St Pancras station in London were facing long queues after several Eurostar services were disrupted following a bomb alert at a French train station.

Source: Evening Standard | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 12 November, 14:50
